label: Bystronic Backfill
info: Backfill + incremental poll van Bystronic jobs/plans/runs vanuit OPC UA History object naar PostgreSQL. 3 modes via inject: TEST (msg.test=true), Start Backfill (full range FROM_DATE..now), Incremental Poll (msg.incremental=true, leest FROM_DATE uit bystronic_sync_state).
